name: UpdateMixStream

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain.

><notice>

Only domain names in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions are supported.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
><notice>目前仅支持华东2（cn-shanghai）和华北2（cn-beijing）两个区域的域名。
></notice>
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the stream mix task. If you created the task by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848087.html operation, use the MixStreamId value returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 合流任务ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848087.html创建合流任务，请查看CreateMixStream接口调用返回的参数MixStreamId值
parameters.name: mix_stream_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of input streams for the mix. This is a JSON array.

For more information, see **InputStreamConfig** below
parameters.help_zh:
合流输入列表，JSON数组。

参考下方的**InputStreamConfig**
parameters.name: input_stream_list

parameters.help_en:
The layout ID. The following values are supported:

- **MixStreamLayout-1-1**

- **MixStreamLayout-2-1**

- **MixStreamLayout-2-2**

- **MixStreamLayout-2-3**

- **MixStreamLayout-3-1**

- **MixStreamLayout-3-2**

- **MixStreamLayout-4-1**

- **USERDEFINED** (If you use a custom layout instead of a preset layout, set this parameter to this value.)
parameters.help_zh:
布局ID。支持：  
- **MixStreamLayout-1-1**
- **MixStreamLayout-2-1**
- **MixStreamLayout-2-2**
- **MixStreamLayout-2-3**
- **MixStreamLayout-3-1**
- **MixStreamLayout-3-2**
- **MixStreamLayout-4-1**
- **USERDEFINED**（非上述预设布局，取固定值**USERDEFINED**）
> 更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199361.html
parameters.name: layout_id
